releases.displayName: Super Duper Pack + free update OUT NOW

notes.title: With goat power comes some responsibility

items.text: Is it a bird? Is it a plane? No, it’s the heroes no one asked for.
Will they help you save the world? Probably not. More likely the opposite.
The Super Duper Pack contains 20 new gears, 6 with abilities, 6 new instincts, and 2 new playable goats.
Alongside all the superhero nonsense, a free update is also available from today. You can now save up to 50 unique gear sets in the customization menu.
The paid Super Duper Pack add-on and the free update are out now!

notes.title: Who would’ve known we would release a superhero goat pack?! We’ve also added some quality-of-life fixes to the base game as a free update, plus smashing a lot of bugs.
